test: We don’t yet have a programme where people affected can talk to each other.
title: You are starting from scratch
intro: We work out with you whether and in what form a programme suits your organisation, and build it with you step by step.
do: Clarify target group, goals and resources
Choose a proven format from our playbook
Set up the platform in your branding
Train coordinators and support the pilot
first: a needs analysis with you and with the people affected
result: A new programme that suits your organisation, with the first matches in the pilot.

test: There are meetings, groups or phone contacts, but not everyone can take part.
title: Your community runs offline
intro: We add a digital component to your existing programme, so that people who can’t take part today can join too.
do: Analyse who takes part today and who is missing
Add a digital format that suits your groups
Involve existing volunteers and people affected
Let offline and online work together
first: a review of your current programme
result: Reach more people without giving up what works.

test: We have a programme, but it’s underused or ties up too many resources.
title: Your programme is stalling
intro: We take a close look with you at where things get stuck and refocus the programme in a targeted way.
do: Identify the sticking points together and set priorities
Adapt format and platform in a targeted way
Ease the load on coordinators with clear processes
first: an evaluation of your existing programme
result: A programme that gets used, and coordinators with more breathing room.

test: Our programme is up and running, but we’d like to know more about its impact.
title: You want to show impact
intro: We make visible what your programme achieves: with an established impact measurement tool developed specifically for peer work and based on common standards such as quality of life (QoL).
do: Define impact goals and suitable indicators
Integrate the measurement tool into your existing programme
Analyse and interpret data from day-to-day operation
On request: study design and publication as a commissioned service
result: Robust findings on impact, for your board, foundations and funding reports.
